svg.text: WF-003 — Bufferable fixed write burst and final BRESP

AW follows capture of complete INCR4 Normal Write-back burst. All four W beats are sent; WSTRB is preserved and BRESP error is reported on the final AHB beat. / AW phát sau khi gom đủ burst Normal Write-back INCR4; truyền đủ bốn W beat, giữ WSTRB và báo lỗi BRESP ở beat AHB cuối.
